requirements.title: x-FuSa spec §2.3 exit codes
requirements.text: Every command returns exactly one of: 0 (ok), 1 (gate failure), 2 (usage error), 3 (runtime error).

requirements.title: x-FuSa spec §2.4 severity enum
requirements.text: Finding severity is exactly one of ERROR, WARNING, INFO (uppercase).

requirements.title: x-FuSa spec §2.8 distinct version keys
requirements.text: schemaVersion (report envelopes, MAJOR.MINOR) and specVersion (version/capabilities, full spec release) are never conflated into a single constant.

requirements.title: x-FuSa spec §4.2 fingerprint algorithm
requirements.text: Finding.fingerprint = sha256:hex(ruleId US location.file US normalizedMessage), with digit runs folded to '#' and whitespace collapsed.

requirements.title: x-FuSa spec §1.2 .fusa.json load
requirements.text: project.name and standard are read (MUST); at most one of asil/sil/dal is read; the legacy flat project string form is accepted and normalised.

requirements.title: x-FuSa spec §1.2 .fusa-reqs.json integrity
requirements.text: A duplicate or missing/empty/non-string requirement id surfaces as an ERROR finding rather than being silently merged or dropped.

requirements.title: x-FuSa spec §9.1 version command
requirements.text: adafusa version prints '<tool> <version>' and, under --format json, {tool, version, specVersion} with no envelope.

requirements.title: x-FuSa spec §9.1 capabilities command
requirements.text: adafusa capabilities reports the commands, per-command formats, and standards this build actually supports.

requirements.title: x-FuSa spec §9.1 init command
requirements.text: adafusa init creates .fusa.json and .fusa-reqs.json; --force overwrites; a missing required value with no TTY exits 2, never a placeholder.

requirements.title: x-FuSa spec §4 check command
requirements.text: adafusa check runs every registered rule, emits a findings[] + summary, and gates (exit 1) on any open ERROR (or WARNING under --strict).

requirements.title: x-FuSa spec §5 trace command
requirements.text: adafusa trace computes tracedRequirements/testedRequirements/secTestedRequirements and gates on --req-coverage/--sec-tested/--strict thresholds.

requirements.title: Tool qualification (qualify command)
requirements.text: adafusa qualify runs a known-answer test against every registered rule and writes qualify-report.json.

requirements.title: Release evidence (release command)
requirements.text: adafusa release writes sbom.json (x-FuSa SBOM v1); --full additionally writes provenance.json, artifact-manifest.json, and audit-pack.zip.

requirements.title: Evidence bundling (audit-pack command)
requirements.text: adafusa audit-pack bundles every existing input/generated evidence file plus a manifest.json into a single flat ZIP archive.

requirements.title: x-FuSa spec §9.1 report command
requirements.text: adafusa report re-runs analysis fresh and always exits 0 regardless of findings (only usage/runtime errors apply).

requirements.title: x-FuSa spec §1.4 annotation scanning
requirements.text: -- fusa:req / -- fusa:test / -- fusa:sec-test comments are scanned for exactly one requirement id per line, without false-positiving on prose or string-literal content that merely mentions the marker.

requirements.title: Starter Ada coding-standard rule pack
requirements.text: 8 rules (ADA001-ADA008), drawn from the Ada Quality and Style Guide, are registered and match case-insensitively against Ada source (Ada is a case-insensitive language).

requirements.title: Zero-dependency JSON parser/writer
requirements.text: JSON parsing and serialisation are implemented against the Ada standard library only, reject malformed input (RFC 8259) with Json_Error rather than crashing, and bound recursion depth.

requirements.title: Zero-dependency SHA-256
requirements.text: SHA-256 (FIPS 180-4) is implemented against the Ada standard library only and matches the standard test vectors.

requirements.title: Zero-dependency ZIP writer
requirements.text: A STORED-method ZIP archive writer is implemented against the Ada standard library only, producing archives that pass standard unzip integrity checks.

requirements.title: Absolute projectRoot in report output
requirements.text: The projectRoot field emitted by check/trace/report JSON output is resolved to an absolute path, regardless of whether --dir was given as relative or absolute (spec section 3.2, SHOULD).

requirements.title: SARIF result.properties carries category/standard/clause
requirements.text: SARIF output includes a properties object on each result with category, and standard/clause when non-blank, so format-invariant identifiers stay consistent between the json and sarif formats (spec section 2.9, SHOULD).

requirements.title: Style-only starter rules report category 'style', not 'safety'
requirements.text: ADA005 (line length), ADA006 (tab character), and ADA008 (Warnings suppression) report category 'style' rather than the blanket ADA-prefix 'safety' mapping, so a consumer filtering by category does not see style nits bundled in with safety-relevant findings.

requirements.title: Function-level tag scanner
requirements.text: Scans a project's .ads files for public function/procedure declarations and determines which carry a directly-preceding fusa:req tag, for trace's --func-coverage gate (spec section 1.4.1).

requirements.title: JSON writer container start/end
requirements.text: Object_Start/Object_End/Array_Start/Array_End open and close a JSON object or array, validating balanced nesting and raising Writer_Error on protocol misuse.

requirements.title: JSON writer object key emission
requirements.text: Key emits an object member's key, validating it is only called where an object key is expected.

requirements.title: JSON writer scalar value emission
requirements.text: Value emits a String, Integer, or Boolean scalar as the next array element or object value.

requirements.title: JSON writer null value emission
requirements.text: Null_Value emits a JSON null as the next array element or object value.

requirements.title: JSON writer key+value field shorthand
requirements.text: Field emits a String, Integer, or Boolean key/value pair in a single call, equivalent to Key followed by Value.

requirements.title: JSON writer conditional field emission
requirements.text: Field_If_Non_Blank emits a key/value pair only when the value is non-empty, used for optional report fields.

requirements.title: JSON writer buffer materialization
requirements.text: To_String returns the accumulated JSON document text, independent of whether all containers have been closed.

requirements.title: JSON value kind predicates
requirements.text: Is_Object/Is_Array report whether a parsed JSON value is an object or array, used to validate document shape before further access.

requirements.title: JSON object key presence check
requirements.text: Has_Key reports whether an object value has a given member key, without raising on a missing key.

requirements.title: JSON object member access
requirements.text: Get_Member returns the value of an object member by key, or null if absent, for structural navigation.

requirements.title: JSON scalar value accessors
requirements.text: Get_String/Get_Bool/As_String read a typed scalar value from a parsed JSON value or object member, with a caller-supplied default when absent.

requirements.title: JSON array accessors
requirements.text: Get_Array/Array_Length/Array_Item navigate a parsed JSON array member by key, length, and 1-indexed element.

requirements.title: CLI command dispatch
requirements.text: Run dispatches argv (excluding argv[0]) to the matching section 9.1 command handler and returns its process exit code.

requirements.title: Rule interface identity contract
requirements.text: Id/Description are the dispatching operations every concrete rule implements to report its stable rule id and human-readable description.

requirements.title: Rule interface execution contract
requirements.text: Run is the dispatching operation every concrete rule implements to scan a project's source files and return its findings.

requirements.title: Rule registration
requirements.text: Register adds a rule to the process-lifetime registry in ascending rule-id order, raising Duplicate_Rule_Error on a colliding id.

requirements.title: Rule registry enumeration
requirements.text: Rule_Count/Get_Rule expose the registered rule set by count and 1-indexed position, in ascending rule-id order.

requirements.title: Rule engine execution over all registered rules
requirements.text: Run_All runs every registered rule over a project's source files and concatenates their findings in rule-id order.

requirements.title: Enum-to-string Image rendering
requirements.text: Image renders a Severity_Kind, Category_Kind, or Disposition_Kind enum value to its canonical lowercase JSON string form.

requirements.title: Location record construction
requirements.text: Make_Location builds a Location record from a project-relative file path and optional line/column/end-line/end-column fields.

requirements.title: Finding record construction with fingerprint
requirements.text: Make_Finding builds a Finding record and computes its section 4.2 fingerprint automatically, so every constructed Finding is fingerprint-consistent.

requirements.title: Rule-id prefix to category mapping
requirements.text: Derive_Category maps a rule id's leading token to a Category_Kind per the shared section 1.5.1 prefix registry, defaulting unrecognised prefixes to Other.

requirements.title: Message normalization for fingerprinting
requirements.text: Normalize_Message collapses digit runs and whitespace per section 4.2, the message form used as fingerprint input.

requirements.title: Glob pattern matching
requirements.text: Match reports whether a glob pattern (supporting * and ?) matches a given text, used for exclude-pattern evaluation.

requirements.title: Exclude-pattern matching for source scan
requirements.text: Is_Excluded reports whether a project-relative path matches any configured exclude pattern, used by source file discovery.

requirements.title: Default project configuration
requirements.text: Default_Config builds a Project_Config with the standard default field values for a given project name.

requirements.title: Config file presence check
requirements.text: Exists reports whether a canonical or legacy .fusa.json config file is present under a project root.

requirements.title: Config file persistence
requirements.text: Save writes a Project_Config to .fusa.json in the canonical nested-project-object shape.

requirements.title: Requirements file presence check
requirements.text: Requirements_Exist reports whether a canonical or legacy .fusa-reqs.json requirements file is present under a project root.

requirements.title: Requirements file persistence
requirements.text: Save_Requirements writes a Requirement_List to .fusa-reqs.json.

requirements.title: CRC-32 checksum computation
requirements.text: Compute implements the IEEE 802.3 CRC-32 algorithm over a String, used for ZIP archive entry checksums.

requirements.title: Source file discovery over configured source dirs
requirements.text: Find_Source_Files walks the configured sourceDirs (or the whole project root if unset) and returns every .ads/.adb path not matching an exclude pattern.

requirements.title: Filesystem existence/kind predicates
requirements.text: Exists/Is_Directory report whether a path exists and, if so, whether it is a directory.

requirements.title: Whole-file read into a String
requirements.text: Read_File reads a file's full contents into a String, raising Read_Error uniformly regardless of the underlying I/O failure.

requirements.title: Whole-file write from a String
requirements.text: Write_File writes a String's full contents to a file, creating or overwriting it.

requirements.title: Path join with dot-segment normalisation
requirements.text: Join concatenates a directory and name with a single '/' separator and strips '.' path segments from the result.

requirements.title: Project-relative path derivation
requirements.text: Relative_To strips a project root prefix from an absolute path at an exact '/' boundary, returning the path unchanged if it is not actually under the root.

requirements.title: Line splitting for source scanning
requirements.text: Split_Lines splits file content into a list of lines, tolerating both LF and CRLF line endings.

requirements.title: RFC3339 timestamp generation
requirements.text: Now_Rfc3339 renders the current UTC time as an RFC3339 timestamp, used for the report envelope's generatedAt field.

requirements.title: Common report envelope header emission
requirements.text: Write_Header emits the section 3.1 common JSON header fields shared by every report document kind.

requirements.title: Report-document extension fields emission
requirements.text: Write_Report_Extension emits the section 3.2 report-document extension fields (projectRoot, project, standard, asil, sil, dal).

requirements.title: Findings array emission
requirements.text: Write_Findings_Array emits a findings array in the common JSON finding shape (section 4).

requirements.title: Findings summary emission
requirements.text: Write_Summary emits a findings-count-by-severity summary object.

requirements.title: Text-format findings rendering
requirements.text: Render_Text renders a findings list as a human-readable text report with a trailing summary line.

requirements.title: Strict-mode gate failure determination
requirements.text: Has_Gate_Failure reports whether a findings list should fail a strict-mode gate: any ERROR always gates, a WARNING only gates under --strict.

requirements.title: Dispositions file presence check
requirements.text: Dispositions_Exist reports whether a .fusa-dispositions.json file is present under a project root.

requirements.title: Dispositions file loading
requirements.text: Load_Dispositions parses .fusa-dispositions.json into a Disposition_List, returning an empty list when absent and treating an entry with a missing or unrecognised status as never-applicable.

requirements.title: Disposition matching and orphan detection
requirements.text: Apply_Dispositions matches each finding to a disposition entry per spec section 4.1 (fingerprint primary key; ruleId+file+line or ruleId-only rule-level fallback) and sets its disposition accordingly; an accepted or deferred entry matching no finding surfaces a DISP001 WARNING (category config), while an orphaned rejected entry is silent.

requirements.title: HTML findings rendering
requirements.text: Render_Html renders a findings list as a self-contained HTML page with a findings table, HTML-escaping message/rule-id content, for check and report --format html.

requirements.title: Markdown findings rendering
requirements.text: Render_Md renders a findings list as a GitHub-Flavored Markdown table, escaping a literal pipe character in message content, for report --format md and (in a requirements-table shape) trace --format md.

requirements.title: init --migrate legacy file rename
requirements.text: init --migrate performs a one-shot explicit rename of legacy .adafusa.json/.adafusa-reqs.json to their canonical names, distinct from the automatic legacy-fallback-with-warning Load/Load_Requirements already perform transparently.

requirements.title: release SPDX document emission
requirements.text: release --spdx-version emits a <name>-<version>.spdx.json document (SPDX 2.2/2.3 JSON shape) alongside sbom.json when the flag is present; --spdx-version defaults to 2.3 and 3.0.1 (JSON-LD graph model) is explicitly rejected as not yet implemented.

requirements.title: qualify hash field (RFC 8785 JCS)
requirements.text: qualify emits a hash field computed as sha256: + hex(SHA-256(canonical)), where canonical is the document (results sorted by name, hash field itself absent, generatedAt blanked) serialised per RFC 8785 JSON Canonicalization Scheme, making the hash reproducible across independent runs of the same known-answer results.

requirements.title: CWE-mapped security starter rule pack
requirements.text: SEC001-SEC004 detect possible hardcoded credentials (password/secret/api_key identifiers assigned a literal, CWE-798), a weak hash algorithm reference (GNAT.MD5, CWE-327), and external process spawning (GNAT.OS_Lib.Spawn, CWE-78), each honouring a trailing -- fusa:unsafe justification comment.

requirements.title: Project-structure starter rule pack
requirements.text: FUSA001-FUSA004 check for the presence of a .gpr project file, a LICENSE file, a README file, and .github/workflows CI configuration at the project root, mirroring java-FuSa's project-structure rule category.

requirements.title: Cyclomatic complexity analysis
requirements.text: Fusa.Comp.Analyze computes McCabe cyclomatic complexity V(G) per subprogram body in .adb files via text-based decision-point counting (if/elsif, case/exception-handler when, for/while loop headers, exit-when, and-then/or-else), attributing a nested subprogram's decision points to its innermost enclosing subprogram rather than reporting it as a separate result.

requirements.title: comp command (DO-178C 6.3.4)
requirements.text: comp gates on cyclomatic complexity: exits 1 when any function's V(G) exceeds the threshold, 0 otherwise. Threshold defaults to 10 (DAL-B); --dal derives A<=4/B<=10/C<=15/D<=20 and overrides an explicit --threshold; --format json writes the section 9.2 comp-report.json shape.

requirements.title: .fusa-hara.json load/validate/scaffold
requirements.text: Hara_Exists/Load_Hara/Scaffold_Hara handle the ISO 26262-3 hazard analysis input file: a hazard missing id is an ERROR finding and excluded from the returned list; a hazard with an id but missing any other required field is a WARNING finding but still returned; an absent file can be scaffolded with an empty hazards array.

requirements.title: .fusa-tara.json load/validate/scaffold
requirements.text: Tara_Exists/Load_Tara/Scaffold_Tara handle the ISO 21434 ch.9 threat analysis input file, mirroring Load_Hara's validation rule (missing id is ERROR and excluded; missing other required fields is WARNING but still returned), including a mitigations string array per threat.

requirements.title: hara command
requirements.text: hara scaffolds .fusa-hara.json (with a message to fill it in) when absent, else loads/validates it and emits the section 3.1 envelope plus hazards[]/findings[]/summary; gates (exit 1) on any ERROR-severity validation finding.

requirements.title: tara command
requirements.text: tara scaffolds .fusa-tara.json (with a message to fill it in) when absent, else loads/validates it and emits the section 3.1 envelope plus threats[]/findings[]/summary; gates (exit 1) on any ERROR-severity validation finding.

requirements.title: vuln command
requirements.text: vuln emits a section 4 finding-list (per the spec section 13 canonical direction for vuln.json). No vulnerability database is integrated: an alire.toml present in the project surfaces one INFO finding documenting that limitation; its absence produces an empty (clean) finding list. Wired into release --full, replacing the prior always-skipped stub.

requirements.title: HMAC-SHA256
requirements.text: Fusa.Hmac.Sha256_Hex implements HMAC-SHA256 per RFC 2104 (key hashed down when longer than the 64-byte block size, zero-padded when shorter), built on Fusa.Sha256, for evidence-file integrity signing. Verified against RFC 4231 test vectors 1 and 6.

requirements.title: Dispositions file persistence (write side)
requirements.text: Save_Dispositions writes a Disposition_List to .fusa-dispositions.json, for the disposition add management verb.

requirements.title: .fusa-pr.json load/save
requirements.text: Pr_Exists/Load_Pr/Save_Pr handle the DO-178C section 11.17 problem-report log file, mirroring Load_Requirements/Save_Requirements's pattern.

requirements.title: req management command
requirements.text: req list prints all requirements from .fusa-reqs.json; req add <id> <title> appends a new requirement, rejecting a duplicate id with a usage error.

requirements.title: disposition management command
requirements.text: disposition list prints all entries from .fusa-dispositions.json; disposition add <fingerprint-or-ruleId> <accepted|deferred|rejected> [rationale] appends a new entry, distinguishing a fingerprint from a bare rule id by the sha256: prefix a fingerprint always carries, and rejecting an unrecognised status with a usage error.

requirements.title: hooks management command
requirements.text: hooks install writes an executable .git/hooks/pre-commit running check --strict, refusing to overwrite a hook it did not itself install (detected via a marker comment) or to run outside a git repository; hooks remove deletes only a hook it installed.

requirements.title: sign management command
requirements.text: sign sign <file> computes an HMAC-SHA256 (via --key or --key-file) over the file's content and writes <file>.sig; sign verify recomputes and compares, exiting 1 (gate fail) on a mismatch.

requirements.title: .fusa-metrics.json history and metrics command
requirements.text: Load_Metrics/Save_Metrics persist an append-only history of safety-metric snapshots (requirement count, check severity counts, comp violations). metrics record captures and appends a new snapshot from a live check/comp run; metrics (no subcommand) lists the recorded history.

requirements.title: pr management command
requirements.text: pr init scaffolds .fusa-pr.json; pr add <id> <title> appends an open problem report; pr list prints all reports; pr close <id> marks a report closed with a resolution and timestamp, rejecting an unknown id with a usage error.

requirements.title: standards gap-objectives data model
requirements.text: Fusa.Config models .fusa-<standard>-objectives.json (id/title/clause/status/evidence/findings per objective) with Gap_Objectives_File/Gap_Objectives_Exist/Load_Gap_Objectives/Scaffold_Gap_Objectives, following the hara/tara pattern: a missing id is an ERROR and excludes the entry, an invalid status is a WARNING but the entry is still returned.

requirements.title: standards gap-report commands
requirements.text: do178/iso26262/iso21434/iec61508/iec62443/unece/slsa each scaffold a starter .fusa-<standard>-objectives.json template on first run (do178 ships a small, explicitly non-authoritative reference starter; the rest start empty), then on subsequent runs load/validate/render the human-recorded assessment as a <standard>-gap-report document with an objective status summary. They gate only on structural validation ERRORs (e.g. a missing id), never on the mere presence of gap-status objectives.

requirements.title: SVG status badge rendering
requirements.text: Fusa.Badge.Render_Svg(Label, Message, Color) hand-renders a self-contained shields.io-flat-style SVG document (two colour blocks, centered text), estimating text width from character count since no real font metrics are available without an external library. XML special characters in the label/message are escaped.

requirements.title: verify command (test-suite results validator)
requirements.text: verify loads/validates .fusa-verify.json, the spec's canonical §13 shape {suites:[{name,tests:[{name,result}]}]} (result one of PASS/FAIL/SKIP/ERROR) -- ada-FuSa cannot itself determine whether a project's verification activities passed, so a human or CI pipeline records each test's outcome and this command only aggregates (passed/failed always computed from the individual tests, never trusted from redundant input) and validates structure. Gates on a missing suite/test name or any FAIL result.

requirements.title: diff command (baseline comparison by fingerprint)
requirements.text: diff --baseline <file> compares a live check run (never a second saved file) against a prior check --format json snapshot, by finding fingerprint, emitting the spec's canonical §13 shape {added:[fingerprint], removed:[fingerprint], unchanged:N} -- bare fingerprint strings, not full finding objects. Gates when any added finding is ERROR severity, or (with --strict) when any finding was added at all; a removed finding never gates.

requirements.title: badge command (SVG status badge)
requirements.text: badge runs the same check pipeline as check (rules + dispositions) and renders a red/yellow/green SVG status badge via Fusa.Badge based on error/warning counts; --label/--message/--color let it render an arbitrary custom badge without running check at all. Always exits 0.

requirements.title: package/unit dependency graph module
requirements.text: Fusa.Deps.Analyze extracts each Ada source file's package name and its context-clause with/private-with dependencies via text scanning (Fusa.Files.Split_Lines), merging a unit's .ads and .adb into one node and filtering to intra-project dependencies only. A with appearing after the unit's own package/procedure/function line (e.g. an aspect-specification with) is correctly excluded, since scanning stops there. Find_By_File resolves a changed file to its unit; Reverse_Reachable does a breadth-first search for every unit that (directly or transitively) depends on a given unit.

requirements.title: boundary command (dependency graph)
requirements.text: boundary renders Fusa.Deps.Analyze's dependency graph as Graphviz DOT or Mermaid. Purely descriptive -- always exits 0, no gating threshold.

requirements.title: impact command (change-impact analysis)
requirements.text: impact <file...> resolves each given file to its unit via Fusa.Deps.Find_By_File, then unions Reverse_Reachable across all resolved units to report which other units would be affected. A file that isn't a recognised project unit is reported as such rather than erroring, since not every changed file is Ada source. Always exits 0.

requirements.title: coupling command (structural graph metric)
requirements.text: coupling reuses Fusa.Deps.Analyze's dependency graph, emitted as --format json's canonical §13 shape {modules:[{name,fanIn,fanOut}], edges:[{from,to,weight}], metrics:{...}} -- a graph, not a flat finding-list-shaped array (the spec explicitly warns against deepening investment in that shape). --format text lists units sorted by total coupling, most-coupled first. A STRUCTURAL proxy via the with-clause graph, not a full DO-178C section 6.4.4.3 data/control coupling analysis (which needs source-level parameter/global-data flow analysis this tool does not perform). Always exits 0.

requirements.title: fmea command (design FMEA)
requirements.text: fmea loads/validates .fusa-fmea.json (failure mode, effect, cause, severity/occurrence/detection ratings 1-10, mitigation) following the hara/tara input-file pattern, since failure-mode identification and ratings are a human safety engineer's judgement this tool cannot generate. It computes RPN = severity*occurrence*detection when not explicitly given, and flags (but does not overwrite) an explicit rpn that disagrees with the computed value. Supports text/json/csv output. Gates only on a missing id. Entries carry mitigations[] (an array, per the spec's canonical §13 shape), not a single mitigation string.

requirements.title: safety-case command (GSN safety case)
requirements.text: safety-case loads/validates .fusa-safety-case.json (a GSN goal/strategy/context/solution/assumption/justification node graph with supportedBy/inContextOf edges) following the same input-file pattern -- argument soundness is a certification engineer's judgement this tool cannot make, so it validates only structural well-formedness (unique non-empty ids; every reference resolves to a real node) and renders the graph as a text/md outline or a Mermaid diagram, never claiming the argument itself is valid or complete. Gates on a missing id or a dangling reference. --format json emits the spec's canonical §13 shape {nodes:[{id,type,text}], edges:[{from,to,type}]} -- supportedBy/inContextOf are promoted to a top-level edges[] array rather than embedded per-node, even though the input file still records them per-node for authoring convenience.
